<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=09|day=14|content=
* [[Sweden and the euro]]: [[Sweden|Swedish]] voters reject joining the [[Economic and Monetary Union of the European Union]] and adopting the [[Euro]], with [[2003 Swedish euro referendum|56.1 percent of voters voting no]].
* A [[2003 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état|military coup d'état]] is reported in [[Guinea-Bissau]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/09/14/guineabissau_030914 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050322003025/http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/09/14/guineabissau_030914 |archive-date=2005-03-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Estonian European Union membership referendum, 2003]]: [[Estonia]]ns vote, 66.8 percent to 33.2 percent, to [[Enlargement of the European Union|join the European Union]].
* [[World Trade Organization Ministerial Conference of 2003]]: [[World Trade Organization]] talks collapse in [[Cancún]], Mexico. Rich and poor countries are unable to find common ground. The meetings have been the subject of [[anti-globalization]] protests.<ref name="cbc.ca1">{{Cite web |url=http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/09/14/wto030914 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050322000244/http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/09/14/wto030914 |archive-date=2005-03-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Some of the severe [[wildfire]]s in [[British Columbia]] have been contained, including the one threatening [[Kelowna, British Columbia|Kelowna]]. The one near [[Kamloops, British Columbia|Kamloops]] is still threatening structures. This has been the worst wildfire season in BC in fifty years (→ [[List_of_wildfires_in_British_Columbia#2003|List of wildfires in British Columbia]]).<ref name="cbc.ca1"/>
* [[Yetunde Price]], sister of [[Venus Williams]] and [[Serena Williams]] was shot down during a gang shootout in [[Compton, California|Compton]].
